# sigma_team (Resource)

A Sigma team. Teams group members for permissioning and user-attribute assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_team" "analytics" {
  name        = "analytics"
  description = "Analytics team — owns the data-warehouse-side model."
  visibility  = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `visibility` (String) `public` or `private`. Defaults to `private`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Sigma team UUID.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_team.example '<team_id>'
```
